verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a note-taking app with sync and publish services, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for vault or sync events. The Obsidian URI protocol only triggers inbound actions, and the plugin API is a developer building block, so neither counts as a webhooks capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
